training.title: Model Training
training.diagnosticOn: Diagnostic mode is ON — training will be noticeably slower. It is meant for reproducing a problem; turn it off under Settings → Diagnostics once you have.
training.stoppedWithWarnings: Training stopped, but there were warnings before it did
training.stoppedWithWarningsHint: Below is the last output from the training process. The full record is in the log file — if this stop was not what you intended (for example you only pressed stop because it had frozen), send us that day's log and we can find the cause.
training.projectNewBody: One project = one data set + one training slot per architecture. The name can be changed later.
training.projectRenameBody: Changes the display name only. The directory on disk, existing checkpoint file names and already-exported models are all unaffected.
training.projectForgetBody: The directory for "{{name}}" is no longer on disk. Removing the entry only takes it out of this list — no files are deleted.
training.projectEmpty: No training projects yet. Create one, import audio, and you can start training.
training.projectNeedsAttention: Needs attention: the upgrade could not tell which architecture this is. Its contents were left untouched.
training.projectMissing: Directory is no longer on disk
training.diffAttachLater: Pick the SoVITS model to attach to in the run step, once training finishes.
training.projectDatasetEmpty: No data imported yet. All four architectures share this one set.
training.projectDatasetOrderNote: The number is the singer's id inside the model (emb_g). If you ever rebuild this data set to keep training, it must be listed in exactly this order — one singer out of place and every voice is mapped to the wrong id.
training.projectDatasetOrderUnknown: Order not recorded: this multi-singer data has never been trained and carries no import record, so it is listed by name. Whatever order you set on the data page for the first run becomes its order from then on.
training.datasetRemoveTitle: Remove this file from the data set
training.datasetRemoveBody:
"{{name}}" will be deleted from this project's data set (the original file on your computer is untouched).
An architecture in this project has already trained: changing the data means its next run has to redo slicing and feature extraction (slow, but no progress is lost).
training.datasetReplaceWarn: This project already holds {{count}} file(s). Picking files here REPLACES all of them — to add or remove just a few, use the data list on the project page instead.
training.projectDatasetNamesMissing: {{count}} of these files have no record of their original name (imported before this version), so their position in the data set is shown instead.
training.projectExportedNone: Nothing has been exported from this project yet.
training.familySovitsDesc: Quality · 4.1 (vec768 / volume embedding) or 4.0 (vec256, 4.0-ecosystem compatible) · shallow diffusion lives here too · 44.1k
training.slotRetrainBody:
This starts a NEW run under the {{family}} architecture, from scratch. The existing progress ({{size}}) is kept as it is, and so are the data set and the other architectures.
The new run takes the name you enter next; the old run can still be resumed.
training.slotResumeLatest: Can resume from the latest checkpoint
training.slotNoResume: Has archives, but no resumable checkpoint
training.slotPrepPoolsHint: Preprocessed data (slices, f0, features) is stored per parameter identity. Changing the dataset or a preprocessing setting adds another set; the old one is kept so you can switch back at any time. Cleanup arrives in a later version.
training.runNameBody: Used for the artifact file names and the model name; defaults to the project name. Later resumes keep using it.
training.newRunNameBody: Retrain starts a NEW run and leaves the existing one untouched. The name is used in this run's artifact file names, so it cannot repeat a run that already exists in this architecture.
training.newRunNameTaken: This architecture already has a run with that name
training.dataHint: Import clean vocal recordings. If separation/denoising is needed, process them on the track area first, export, then import here.
training.multiSpeakerHint: One singer by default. Click "+ Add singer" to add more — the trained model can then blend these voices by ratio in the voice-conversion node.
training.addSpeakerBody:
Name this singer. The name decides its voice slot in the model, and rebuilding this data set later means retyping it EXACTLY — so pick one you will recognise.
Next you will choose its audio: a singer with no audio does not exist.
training.datasetRemoveSpeakerBody:
The {{count}} audio file(s) of "{{name}}" will be deleted from this project's data set (the originals on your computer are untouched).
The number and order of singers decide the model's voice slots, so removing one makes an architecture already trained on the current layout impossible to continue.
training.backendDiffDesc: SoVITS companion model · same name as the main model reuses its preprocessing caches · 44.1k
training.backendVocoderDesc: Fine-tune a singer's own NSF-HiFiGAN · better SoVITS diffusion/enhancer quality · shared by all their models
training.vocScopeValue: SoVITS (4.0/4.1) shallow diffusion & enhancer · 44.1kHz / hop 512 / 128 mel · RVC has no external vocoder interface
training.vocTotalStepsTip: Official guidance: ~2000 steps finish a small-dataset fine-tune
training.vocLicenseNote: Base model = the openvpi community vocoder 2024.02 (not shipped with the app; downloaded separately after you confirm, on first use); its weights are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and fine-tuned results inherit that license (non-commercial).
training.vocFixedNote: Fixed: 44.1kHz / hop 512 / 128 mel (the OpenVPI standard format) · f0 = parselmouth · fp32 training · base = community vocoder 2024.02
training.vocCropTip: Mel frames of the random training window: 32 = 16GB preset, 48 = 24GB preset
training.vocFreezeMpd: Freeze the MPD discriminator (official tip for short fine-tunes)
training.vocFreezeMpdTip: Freezes the multi-period discriminator, training only the generator and MSD — the official README suggests it may help short fine-tunes
training.fixedNote: Fixed: f0 = RMVPE · features = ContentVec · retrieval index = auto-built
training.sovitsFixedNote: Fixed: 44.1kHz · f0 = RMVPE · features = ContentVec · retrieval/cluster assets built at preprocessing
training.resumeLockedTip: This value is baked into the artifacts this architecture already produced, so a resume cannot change it. To change it, choose Retrain at start — that creates a NEW run with the new settings and leaves the existing run untouched.
training.resumeLockedNote: Fields marked "locked for resume" cannot change: they are baked into the existing model, and changing one makes it impossible to continue. To change them, pick retrain at start.
training.resumeCostlyTip: This value decides WHICH set of preprocessing products (slices, f0, features) this architecture trains on. Change it and the next run switches to a different set and rebuilds all of it — the bigger the dataset, the longer that takes. No model progress is lost, and the previous set stays on disk.
training.cacheAllData: Cache dataset in RAM (recommended for diffusion)
training.diffFixedNote: Fixed: 44.1kHz · mel = NSF-HiFiGAN recipe · features/pitch share the same-named main model's caches · keyshift augmentation on · loudnorm/volume embedding follow the main workspace
training.diffNoBase40: No public diffusion base model exists for 4.0 (vec256) — training starts from scratch; consider more total steps
training.diffWorkspaceForeign: A same-named workspace belongs to another backend ({{family}}) — please pick a different model name
training.diffConfirmResumeBody: "{{name}}" already has {{steps}} trained diffusion steps. Resume continues from there; retrain clears ONLY the diffusion progress (main-model checkpoints and preprocessing caches are kept).
training.diffConfirmReuseBody: The preprocessing caches of workspace "{{name}}" will be reused (use the same dataset as the main model). Retrain = clear this workspace's diffusion progress and start over.
training.diffRetrainFullWipeNote: Note: this workspace has no main-model checkpoints — retraining wipes the ENTIRE workspace (preprocessing caches included).
training.retrainWipesDiff: Note: this workspace also holds shallow-diffusion training progress ({{steps}} steps) — retraining will wipe it too.
training.noAttachTarget: No installed SoVITS model to attach to (feature dims must match) — import the main model first, then attach here
training.volEmbedding: Volume embedding (inference loudness follows the input)
training.loudnorm: Loudness normalize (peak to 0dB — upstream default, lossy)
training.kmeansOpt: Train kmeans cluster centers instead of retrieval
training.allInMem: Keep dataset in RAM (speeds up small datasets)
training.saveWeights: Export a small model at each save
training.keepLatest: Keep only the latest big checkpoint (saves disk)
training.noGpuCpuNote: No trainable GPU detected — this run will train on CPU (very slow)
training.noUsableGpuNote: None of the GPUs listed above can be used for training right now (each row says why). Install the matching training runtime pack to make one selectable, or tick "Force CPU training" below to continue.
training.clearResultTip: Clears only the last run's results and curve shown on this page; the workspace and checkpoints are kept, resuming is unaffected
training.clearResultConfirmBody: Clear this page's training results and curve? Workspace and checkpoint files are kept and resuming is unaffected, but this list (with each checkpoint's audition/import/attach buttons) will no longer be shown, and the audition cache will be deleted.
training.auditionSpeakerTip: Which speaker of the multi-speaker model to audition; does not affect the kept checkpoints (a checkpoint always contains every speaker)
training.auditionNeedHost: Select an attach target model first
training.importSelectedBody: The selected checkpoints will be imported with these names (existing same-name models are replaced; use the per-row Import button to customize a name):
training.envMissingBody:
Training needs the embedded Python runtime (a GPU pack matching your card, or the universal CPU pack).
Download it in Settings → Training Runtime, then start training.
training.assetsMissingBody: This run needs the following files, which are not installed yet:
training.assetsLicenseNote: This includes weights licensed {{license}}: they are not shipped with the app itself — they download separately once you confirm, together with their NOTICE attribution files. A vocoder finetuned from them inherits the same license (non-commercial).
training.forceStopConfirmBody: Force termination does not save current progress (the last checkpoint is kept). Terminate?
training.augCopiesTip: Experimental: generates N PSOLA pitch-shifted copies (within ±3 semitones) per slice to expand the dataset (time-domain, formant-preserving — timbre is unchanged). A per-slice quality gate drops bad copies automatically (details in the workspace's aug_gate_report.json); augmented copies never enter the validation set or retrieval assets. Note: the dataset grows to about (1+N)×, so steps per epoch grow accordingly — budget training by total steps, not epochs. 0 = off
training.augFollowWorkspace: Copy count follows the main training's setting (not adjustable here)
training.diffPoolHint: Shallow diffusion shares one data pool with the main training: start without importing to use the main training's existing data, or import here to REPLACE the shared pool with new data (affects this and future diffusion runs only — the already-trained main model is unaffected)
training.errorHint: See train.log in the training workspace for details
training.modelVersionMismatchBody: A model named "{{name}}" ({{old}}) already exists and there is no resumable workspace. {{new}} is selected — training starts from scratch; importing under the same name afterwards replaces the existing model.
training.noWorkspaceBody: A model named "{{name}}" already exists but there is no resumable training workspace — training starts from scratch; importing under the same name afterwards replaces the existing model.
training.confirmExistBody: "{{name}}" already exists. Resume continues from the last checkpoint; Retrain starts a NEW run from scratch and leaves the existing one untouched.
training.archiveEmpty: This architecture has no archive yet.
training.probeFailed: Could not read the training-workspace state for this model name ({{err}}) — training was NOT started, so existing progress cannot be wiped by mistake. Try again; if it keeps happening, check that the training data directory is readable (permissions / antivirus / cloud-sync lock)
training.dropHint: Drop here to add as training data
training.ckptRangeTip: Auto range-test result (comfort zone) — auditions transpose the high-skewed clip into this zone and back
training.runRenameBody: The training name is just this run's label — changing it moves none of the files it has already produced and does not affect resuming. Models already exported to the resource manager keep their own names.
training.importReplaceTitle: A model with this name is already installed
training.importReplaceBody: A model named "{{name}}" is already in the resource manager. Continuing REPLACES it: the old model's files (retrieval matrix, cluster, avatar, measured range) are deleted. ⚠ Saved projects remember their voice by MODEL NAME, so any project using the old one will use this new model the next time it is opened. To keep both, pick a different name.

vocalEditor.title: Vocal
vocalEditor.snapNotesTip: Snap notes to the grid (off = free placement; the lines stay as a reference)

sidebar.formantTip: Track-wide formant shift (semitones), added on top of the bottom formant lane. Higher = brighter/younger, lower = darker/fuller; 0 = no change.
sidebar.consonantTip: Output gain on voiceless onsets (s/k/t…): higher = crisper articulation. 0 = off; default 2.5 dB.
sidebar.consonantValleyTip: Energy valley at syllable boundaries (voiced consonants too — r/m/n rows): real singing dips between every syllable, most audibly in fast runs. Higher = more separated syllables. 0 = off; default 1×.
sidebar.vowelClarityTip: Render fast-run short vowels at an inflated duration and resample back (cv-domain — no time-stretch artifacts), so 40-80 ms vowels still reach their target articulation. Default on.
sidebar.consonantPrerollTip: Sing a syllable's opening consonant AHEAD of the beat so the vowel lands on it — what real singers do, what the training data annotates, and what a UTAU voicebank's preutterance does. Keep it ON for UTAU CVVC / VCCV alias scores too: their pre-utterance lives in each note's own PreUtterance field, and UTAU moves the SAMPLE, never the note's position (measured on the four reference USTs: against the 1/8-beat unit these files are written on, the median start offset is 0 for every onset class and longer consonants do not start earlier, with no ordering by consonant length) — our pre-roll is the analogue of preutterance, applied once. With it off, the consonant comes out of this note's own duration and nothing is ever borrowed from the previous note (it can take at most half the note; on a note too short to spare even 2 frames it is dropped) — the positions the author placed do not move at all. One exception: a short vowel may still extend into the rest immediately after it, which only eats silence and never moves a note's start. The phoneme lane shows the resulting split. Default on.
sidebar.breathTokenTip: Notes with this lyric render as a breath; set it to any word you like. AP/ap are always breath.
sidebar.restTokenTip: Notes with this lyric render as a rest: silent, and the pitch line breaks over them — exactly like leaving a gap. R/r are always a rest. Pick something that never occurs as a real lyric: an ordinary word silences every note carrying it, and rests get no red mark.
sidebar.trackLangTip: Lyrics on this track convert to phonemes in this language; individual notes can override it below.
sidebar.noteLangTip: Applies only to the selected notes; "Follow track" uses the track default above.
sidebar.phonemeSetTip: Which convention this track's ENGLISH lyrics are written in. Default "Words" = the dictionary (ordinary lyrics). In a UST written for an English UTAU voicebank the lyrics are that bank's sample aliases (-aI / e@n / y uw / &m / 1ng-), and only the right convention can read them. English notes only; a [bracket hint] and a per-note phoneme override still win. An alias the convention cannot read is marked red LOUDLY and never falls back to the dictionary — a third of these aliases are also real English words, so a fallback would silently sing a different one.
sidebar.phonemeSetHint: Read as aliases: what you type stays on ONE note, no space-splitting
sidebar.phonemeHint: English lyrics may carry a phonetic hint, e.g. [dh ae dh]
sidebar.phonemeHintTip: Put ARPABET phonemes in square brackets (the OpenUtau convention) and the note sings exactly those; read[r iy d] works too, and a multi-syllable hint spreads over the following + notes like an ordinary word. ARPABET written WITHOUT a stress digit is read as unstressed: a bare ah is ə — write ah1 for ʌ. Brackets that hold no valid phonemes (empty, or a word) are marked red and never sung as a lyric.
sidebar.rangeExtendTip: Out-of-comfort phrases render transposed into the singer's comfort zone, then shift back in the audio domain (needs a range record from the Resource Manager; in-range renders are untouched)
sidebar.rangeExtendNoRecord: This singer has no range record yet, so the switch has no effect for now. Run a range test on the model in the Resource Manager and it takes effect automatically.
sidebar.rangeFormantTip: How much the formants follow the pitch when a range-extended phrase is shifted back: 0 = keep the singer's timbre as sung (default), 1 = follow fully (cartoonish). Only audible on phrases that actually get shifted
sidebar.autotuneFollowTip: Untuned notes are tuned automatically (manual parameters and drawn pitch lines are never touched)
sidebar.autotuneRigidTip: Flattens the auto-tuned vibrato wobble: +100% = fully rigid, −100% = maximum wobble
sidebar.autotuneExprTip: Scales the whole auto-tune: glide overshoot, edge scoops and vibrato together
sidebar.autotuneTakeTip: Switch the delivery (vibrato phase): the same number is always the same take, dial back anytime. 0 = baseline
sidebar.autotunePaused: Auto follow paused (tuning model not ready) — it resumes automatically once the model is downloaded

backend.DIFFUSION_SPEEDUP_TOO_FEW_STEPS: k_step / speedup leaves too few steps — dpm/unipc samplers need at least 2; lower the speedup
backend.DIFFUSION_SWAP_FAILED: Failed to move out the old diffusion attachment
backend.DIFFUSION_T_OUT_OF_RANGE: Diffusion step count is out of the schedule range
backend.DIFF_VERSION_MISMATCH: The diffusion model must match the workspace's main model version — switch back to the matching version and train again
backend.DIFF_WIPE_FAILED: Failed to clear the diffusion training progress
backend.DOWNLOAD_OVERSIZE: Download exceeded the expected size (cache cleared)
backend.DOWNLOAD_RANGE_INVALID: Resume range invalid (HTTP 416) — cache cleared, please retry
backend.DOWNLOAD_SHA256_MISMATCH: sha256 verification failed — the corrupted download cache was deleted, please retry
backend.DOWNLOAD_STALLED: Download stalled (no data received for too long)
backend.ENVTEST_BUSY: An environment self-test is already running
backend.ENVTEST_CANCELLED: Self-test cancelled (the pack is installed — you can run it manually from the list later)
backend.ENVTEST_CRASHED: The self-test exited abnormally without producing a report
backend.ENVTEST_FAILED: Self-test failed (see envtest.json in the pack / the Settings panel for details)
backend.ENVTEST_OP_FALLBACK_COLD: Some operators ran on the CPU instead of the GPU (not hot ones — limited impact)
backend.ENVTEST_OP_FALLBACK_HOT: Hot operators (conv/STFT/FFT) fell back to the CPU — training will be much slower, especially the vocoder. Usually an incomplete driver or architecture support
backend.ENVTEST_PACKAGES_BROKEN: The runtime pack has missing or broken Python packages — delete the pack and download it again
backend.ENVTEST_TORCH_NO_CUDA: PyTorch cannot use CUDA — usually a graphics driver that is too old or does not match this pack; update the NVIDIA driver and run the self-test again
backend.ENVTEST_REPORT_CLEAR_FAILED: Could not clear the old self-test report
backend.ENVTEST_REPORT_CONTRADICTION: The self-test report contradicts the process exit code — treated as a failure
backend.ENVTEST_SCRIPT_MISSING: Self-test script not found — is the app directory incomplete?
backend.ENVTEST_TIMEOUT: Self-test timed out and was terminated — check whether antivirus is blocking the embedded python.exe
backend.ENVTEST_WAIT_FAILED: Failed to wait on the self-test process
backend.EXPORT_BAD_PCM: Export data transfer corrupted — please retry the export
backend.EXPORT_FFMPEG_MISSING: ffmpeg not found — compressed formats unavailable (WAV still works)
backend.EXPORT_NO_PCM: Export data was lost — please retry the export
backend.EXPORT_WRITE_FAIL: Failed to write the export file
backend.FEATURES_DIM_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported content-feature dimension (only 256 / 768) — check the model config's features_dim / speech_encoder
backend.FFMPEG_MISSING: ffmpeg.exe not found (required for training preprocessing)
backend.INDEX_LOAD_FAILED: Failed to load the retrieval index
backend.INFERENCE_LOW_MEMORY: System memory is too low — GPU inference was stopped to avoid a crash. Close other memory-heavy applications and retry, switch the inference device to CPU in Settings, or use fewer separation nodes in the workflow.
backend.INSTALL_BUSY: A runtime pack is already downloading/installing — wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
backend.INSTALL_COMMIT_WRITE_FAILED: Runtime pack install could not finish: writing the install marker file failed
backend.INSTALL_DISK_FULL: Not enough disk space — stopped before writing more data (anything already downloaded is kept and resumable). Free up space on the target drive (or migrate the data directory to a larger drive first) and retry
backend.INTERNAL_ENHANCER_NO_VOCODER: Internal error: the enhancer is enabled but no vocoder is loaded
backend.INTERNAL_NO_OUTPUT_PATH: Internal error: neither a VITS output nor a diffusion config
backend.INTERNAL_UNIPC_SINGULAR: Internal error: the unipc Vandermonde matrix is singular
backend.LOCAL_FILE_BAD_DIR: Could not resolve the selected file's directory
backend.LOCAL_FILE_BAD_NAME: Could not resolve the selected file name
backend.LOCAL_FILE_BAD_TYPE: Select a .tar.zst runtime pack (or its .part01 volume)
backend.LOCAL_PARTS_GAP: Parts are not contiguous (a volume is missing)
backend.MANIFEST_BAD_ID: The manifest id contains illegal characters
backend.MANIFEST_BAD_PART_NAME: A manifest part name contains illegal characters
backend.MIGRATE_DISK_FULL: Not enough free space on the target drive — the migration did not start; nothing was changed and your data is still in the original location. Free up space and retry
backend.MIGRATE_RESTART_REQUIRED: A migration already completed this session — restart the app before starting another one
backend.MIGRATE_VERIFY_FAILED: Post-migration integrity check failed — nothing was changed, your data is still in the original location. Check the target drive's free space and retry
backend.MODEL_HOP_SIZE_ZERO: The model config's hop_size is 0 — cannot run inference
backend.MODEL_LEGACY_EXPORT: The model is a legacy export (missing the new input signature) — delete it and re-import to upgrade
backend.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: Model not found — import it in the resource manager first
backend.EXPORT_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The model to export was not found — refresh the resource manager and retry
backend.PACKAGE_INVALID: Not a valid Utai model package (missing manifest or core files)
backend.PACKAGE_EXTRACT_FAILED: Failed to read the model package
backend.MODEL_NOT_LOADED: The model is not loaded yet
backend.MSST_DELETE_FAILED: Failed to delete the separation model file
backend.PACK_DELETE_FAILED: Delete failed (could not remove the marker file). If a conversion/self-test just ran, wait a few seconds and retry.
backend.PACK_FORMAT_INVALID: Invalid pack format: the first entry must be pack.json (rebuild with the latest build_pack.py)
backend.PACK_JSON_BAD_ID: The id in pack.json contains illegal characters
backend.PACK_NO_DOWNLOAD_SOURCE: This runtime pack has no published download source yet — use "Install from local file".
backend.PACK_NO_PYTHON: python/python.exe missing from the pack (not a valid runtime pack)
backend.PROBE_CONNECT_FAILED: Could not establish a connection (DNS / network / blocked)
backend.PROBE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Connection timed out (possible network interference or unreachable source)
backend.PROBE_HTTP_ERROR: The source has no test file or refused access
backend.PROBE_TIMEOUT: Connection/response timed out (possible network interference or unreachable source)
backend.RENAME_RETRY_EXHAUSTED: Rename kept being denied after multiple retries — usually antivirus/search indexing is scanning the new files: wait a moment and retry, or add the data folder to the antivirus exclusion list.
backend.RESUME_KSTEP_MISMATCH: Diffusion depth (k_step_max) differs from the existing diffusion progress — resume must keep it, or retrain (clears diffusion progress only)
backend.RESUME_PARAMS_MISMATCH: Resume parameters differ from the original workspace — resume must keep the original version and sample rate, or retrain
backend.RESUME_SPEAKER_COUNT_MISMATCH: Singer count differs from the original workspace — co-training must keep it, or retrain
backend.RESUME_SPEAKER_SET_MISMATCH: Singer set or order differs from the original workspace — co-training must keep the same singers and order, or retrain
backend.RESUME_TARGET_REACHED_DIFF: The diffusion model has already reached the target total steps — increase total steps to resume, or retrain
backend.RESUME_TARGET_REACHED_VOCODER: The vocoder has already reached the target total steps — increase total steps to resume, or retrain
backend.RESUME_VOL_EMBEDDING_MISMATCH: Resume parameter mismatch (loudness embedding) — this switch determines the model architecture; resume must keep it, or retrain
backend.RMVPE_MEL_SHAPE: rmvpe_mel_filters.npy has an unexpected shape — please re-export or re-download it
backend.RMVPE_NO_OUTPUT: The RMVPE model returned no output
backend.RUNTIME_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: The NVIDIA driver is too old for the NVIDIA runtime (CUDA 13 requires driver 580 or newer). Update the driver at nvidia.com and retry; until then the CPU runtime works
backend.RUNTIME_PACK_REQUIRED: Model conversion needs a Python runtime, but no runtime pack is installed. Install the "CPU runtime" pack (about 0.4 GB download) in Settings → Training Runtime, or install the pack matching your GPU, then retry.
backend.RUNTIME_PACK_UNSUPPORTED: This machine cannot run that runtime pack — the Settings download list does not offer it here. Refresh Settings and pick one of the packs it actually lists.
backend.RUNTIME_PATH_NON_ASCII: The runtime install path contains non-ASCII characters. Embedded Python + torch fail to load DLLs under paths with Chinese/Japanese characters — migrate the data folder to an ASCII-only path (e.g. D:\UtaiData) in Settings → Storage first, then retry.
backend.RVC_CHUNK_TOO_SHORT: Audio chunk too short: the model output cannot cover the front/back padding trim
backend.RVC_MIN_FRAMES: Audio chunk too short: frame count is below the model's minimum
backend.RVC_NO_OUTPUT: The RVC model returned no output
backend.RVC_SR_NOT_100FPS: The model sample rate is not a multiple of 100, so it cannot be aligned to the 100 fps frame grid
backend.SCORE2CV_DIM_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported vocal-rendering content dimension (only 256 / 768) — check the selected singer model's features_dim
backend.SCORE2CV_NO_OUTPUT: The ScoreToCV model returned no output
backend.SCORE2SVC_ZERO_FRAMES: Target frame count is 0 (the score is too short)
backend.SHARED_POOL_REUSED: Reusing the shared slice pool (no re-import)
backend.SOVITS_NO_OUTPUT: The SoVITS model returned no output
backend.STRETCH_ENGINE_FAILED: The audio engine (time-stretch / pitch) failed to process this render — try again; if it persists, restart the app
backend.TAR_READ_FAILED: Failed to read the tar archive
backend.TRAINING_ACTIVE: Training is running — try again later
backend.TRAINING_ALREADY_RUNNING: A training run is already in progress
backend.TRAINING_ASSET_MISSING: A required training file is missing — place the file at the indicated path
backend.TRAINING_AUG_COPIES_MAX: Augmentation copies can be at most 3
backend.TRAINING_BACKEND_UNSUPPORTED: This training backend is not implemented (supported: RVC / SoVITS / shallow diffusion / vocoder finetune)
backend.TRAINING_BAD_VOCODER_FORMAT: Invalid vocoder format (only classic NSF-HiFiGAN is supported)
backend.TRAINING_CROP_FRAMES_ZERO: Crop frame count must be greater than 0
backend.TRAINING_GPU_CC_UNKNOWN: Could not read this GPU's compute capability (driver trouble?) — it is not offered for training, to be safe
backend.TRAINING_GPU_NO_RUNTIME: No training runtime exists for this device
backend.TRAINING_GPU_PACK_MISSING: Its training runtime pack is not installed — install it under Settings → Training Runtime and it becomes selectable
backend.TRAINING_GPU_UNKNOWN: The selected GPU is no longer in the available list — please pick again
backend.TRAINING_GPU_UNSUPPORTED: The available training runtime packs cannot drive this GPU
backend.TRAINING_RUNTIME_VARIANT_MISSING: The training runtime pack for the selected GPU disappeared before the run started — aborted; reinstall it under Settings → Training Runtime
backend.TRAINING_GPU_UNAVAILABLE: Training could not access the selected GPU — the run was aborted. Check the GPU driver and try again; if this machine's GPU does not support accelerated training, enable "Force CPU training" in the parameters step to proceed
backend.TRAINING_RUNTIME_CPU_ONLY: A GPU was detected, but only the CPU training runtime pack is installed — the run was aborted instead of silently training on CPU. Install the runtime pack matching your GPU in Settings → Training Runtime; if you really mean to train on CPU, enable "Force CPU training" in the parameters step to proceed
backend.TRAINING_HOST_MEMORY_EXHAUSTED: The system ran out of committed memory (virtual memory) — a data-loading worker could not get memory, and training has most likely stalled. ⚠ It will not report this itself and it will not stop on its own. What helps: raise the Windows pagefile, close anything rendering or otherwise using memory at the same time, or lower the batch size
backend.TRAINING_NO_PROGRESS: Training has reported nothing for a long time — it may be stuck. ⚠ It may also be normal: some AMD integrated GPUs spend several minutes compiling their first convolution kernel. If it does not recover, stop the run and check the log
backend.TRAINING_NUMERICS_DIVERGED: Training diverged numerically (the losses became nan/inf) — the run was aborted instead of carrying on for hours with broken weights. Your previous "best" checkpoint was NOT overwritten and is still usable. Things to try: resume from an earlier checkpoint, lower the learning rate, or check the dataset for corrupt audio
backend.TRAINING_RESUME_DATASET_CHANGED: This run is continuing onto a different dataset than the one the checkpoint was trained on (audio was added or removed, or preprocessing was re-run). This is not an error and training continues — but the discriminator has already spent epochs on the old data, so the first few hundred steps after a data swap usually wobble. If the losses look wrong after this resume, suspect this first.
backend.TRAINING_RESUME_OPTIMIZER_MISSING: This resume could not restore the optimizer's momentum — the archive it continued from carries no optimizer state (shallow-diffusion periodic checkpoints do not, by upstream design). Training continues, but for the next few hundred steps Adam's adaptive step sizes are being rebuilt from scratch, so the loss usually jumps before it settles. ⚠ The checkpoints written from now on carry the full state, so the next resume will not do this.
backend.TRAINING_RESUME_ARCHIVE_POISONED: The archive this run was going to continue from already contains nan/inf — meaning the run that wrote it had gone numerically dead before saving. We will not train on from it, since that only carries the broken values forward. **If an older healthy archive was on disk, this run has already switched to it and continues from that step** — so the step count on screen may be lower than what you saw last time, which is intended. **If nothing healthy was left, the run was stopped**; continue from the best/an earlier archive, or start over.
backend.TRAINING_RESUME_CHECKPOINT_INCOMPLETE: The resume checkpoint does not match the current model (parameters are missing or have the wrong shape). Continuing would substitute freshly random weights for them while still applying the old optimizer momentum — which typically blows up a few hundred steps later — so the run was stopped. Check the workspace's G_*.pth / D_*.pth, or start a fresh training run.
backend.TRAINING_RESUME_CHECKPOINT_UNREADABLE: This workspace has resume checkpoints but they could not be read (truncated or corrupt). The run was stopped rather than silently restarting from the base model at step 0, which would throw away everything you had already trained. Check free disk space and the G_*.pth / D_*.pth files.
backend.TRAINING_IMPORT_COPY_FAILED: Failed to import a data file
backend.TRAINING_INTERNAL_ASSET_BRANCH: Training backend is missing its asset-resolution branch (internal error)
backend.TRAINING_KILL_FAILED: Failed to kill the training process
backend.TRAINING_MULTI_BACKEND: Multi-singer co-training currently supports only SoVITS and RVC
backend.TRAINING_NAME_EMPTY: Model name must not be empty
backend.TRAINING_NO_SHARED_POOL: This model has no reusable main-training workspace data — import training data first
backend.TRAINING_PROCESS_CRASHED: The training process exited abnormally. Common causes: out of VRAM/RAM (OOM), killed by antivirus, or a corrupted training environment. See train.log in the training workspace; recent output is shown in the status panel.
backend.TRAINING_PYTHON_SPAWN_FAILED: Failed to start the training Python (training environment not set up?)
backend.TRAINING_SAVE_INTERVAL_ZERO: Save interval must be greater than 0
backend.TRAINING_SPEAKER_LIMIT: RVC multi-singer co-training supports at most 109 singers
backend.TRAINING_SPEAKER_NAME_DUP: Duplicate singer name (multi-singer co-training requires unique names)
backend.TRAINING_SPEAKER_NAME_EMPTY: Every singer must have a name
backend.TRAINING_SPEAKER_NO_DATA: This singer has no data files
backend.TRAINING_SR_FIXED_44K: This training is fixed at a 44.1 kHz sample rate
backend.TRAINING_THREAD_SPAWN_FAILED: Failed to spawn the training thread
backend.TRAINING_TOTAL_STEPS_ZERO: Total steps must be greater than 0
backend.PROJECT_LEDGER_UNSTAMPED: This training project has no export-ledger baseline (project.json may have been rewritten externally) — cleanup was refused so snapshots you deliberately kept cannot be deleted by mistake.
backend.PROJECT_LEDGER_STALE: None of the checkpoints named in the export ledger are on disk — files were moved or deleted outside the app, so every judgement here is unreliable. Cleanup refused; check the training folder first.
backend.DELETE_OTHER_INSTANCE: Another Utai instance is running and may be using these training files — deletion refused. Close the other Utai windows first.
backend.DELETE_RECLAIM_IN_PROGRESS: The data directory is still reclaiming files in the background; anything deleted now would be copied back. Try again shortly.
backend.TRAINING_DELETE_FAILED: Could not delete the training archives (something may be holding the folder — close Explorer / antivirus scans and retry).
backend.AUDITION_WORKSPACE_OUTSIDE_ROOT: The audition target is not inside the training directory (the project may have been deleted or moved) — refused. Reopen the training page and try again.
backend.AUDITION_WORKSPACE_IS_A_SLOT: The audition target is a training slot rather than one training run — refused, so another run’s cache cannot be read as this one’s. Reopen the training page and try again.
backend.PROJECT_META_WRITE_FAILED: Could not write the training project info (the data directory may be read-only or locked) — check write permissions on the data directory and try again.
backend.PROJECT_META_ENCODE_FAILED: Could not serialize the training project info (internal error).
backend.PROJECT_META_UNREADABLE: This training project's project.json cannot be read (likely corrupted) — handle the project under Settings → Storage, or restore that file from a backup.
backend.PROJECT_NEEDS_ATTENTION: This training project needs attention: the upgrade could not tell which training architecture it belongs to. Its contents were left untouched but not reorganized. Check it under Settings → Storage, or start over with a different model name.
backend.TRAINING_LAYOUT_MIGRATION_PENDING: An older-layout training workspace for this model name has not been reorganized yet (another program may hold the directory, or two copies of Utai are running) — refused, so the existing progress cannot be lost. Close the other Utai windows and anything using that folder, restart the app and try again.
backend.PROJECT_DATASET_IN_USE: Another architecture in this training project was trained on a different set of data — swapping the data now would make its progress unresumable. Restore the original selection, or use a different model name (= a new project).
backend.TRAINING_DATASET_SELF_SOURCE: The selected training data lives inside this project's own dataset folder — select no files at all to reuse the project data, or pick the files from their original location.
backend.PROJECT_DATASET_SHAPE: This project's data is stored per singer (multi-singer co-training) and this run specifies no singer groups, so it cannot reuse it — re-import on the data page with the singers set up.
backend.DATASET_WHILE_BUSY: A task is running — wait for it to finish (or stop it) before changing the data.
backend.DATASET_OTHER_INSTANCE: Another Utai instance is running and may be using this data — the change was refused. Close the other Utai windows first.
backend.DATASET_RECLAIM_IN_PROGRESS: The data directory is still reclaiming files in the background; a change made now would be overwritten. Try again shortly.
backend.DATASET_SPEAKERS_FROZEN: An architecture in this project has already trained on the current singer layout, and the number and order of singers are baked into the model's voice slots — adding or removing a singer would make that architecture impossible to continue. To change the layout, the run that trained on it has to be removed first. Adding or removing audio for an EXISTING singer is not restricted.
backend.FROZEN_SPEAKERS_UNREADABLE: A run's record of its singer layout could not be read (the file may be locked, unreadable, or corrupt) — whether this change is safe cannot be judged without it, so the operation was refused. Check that the training directory is accessible and try again.
backend.DATASET_COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy audio into the project data set
backend.DATASET_DELETE_FAILED: Failed to delete a file from the project data set
backend.DATASET_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to write to the project data set — check that the data directory is writable and the disk is not full.
backend.DATASET_REL_INVALID: That data file path is not valid; the operation was refused.
backend.DATASET_META_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to write the data set index (the audio itself is unaffected) — check that the data directory is writable.
backend.DATASET_META_ENCODE_FAILED: Failed to build the data set index (the audio itself is unaffected).
backend.PROJECT_NAME_EMPTY: Project name must not be empty.
backend.PROJECT_NAME_TOO_LONG: Project name is too long (80 characters max).
backend.PROJECT_NAME_INVALID: Project name contains characters that cannot be used (line breaks, tabs and other control characters).
backend.PROJECT_NOTE_TOO_LONG: Note is too long (500 characters max).
backend.PROJECT_NAME_EXISTS: A training project with this name already exists. Names have to tell projects apart — pick another one.
backend.PROJECT_ID_EXHAUSTED: Could not allocate a free directory name for this project — the training folder already holds many leftovers under this name. Clean up under Settings → Storage and try again.
backend.PROJECT_ID_INVALID: Invalid project id; the action was refused. This is an internal problem — please send us the log.
backend.TRAINING_WIPE_NOT_CONFIRMED: This run holds shallow-diffusion progress and a diffusion-only retrain would erase it — the start request carried no user confirmation, so it was refused. Click Start training again and confirm in the dialog.
backend.RUNS_DIR_UNREADABLE: The list of runs for this architecture could not be read (antivirus, cloud-sync or another program may be holding it). Refused rather than treating it as「this architecture has never trained」and overwriting existing progress. Close whatever may be holding the folder and try again.
backend.POOLS_DIR_UNREADABLE: The preprocessing pool folder for this architecture could not be read (antivirus, cloud-sync or another program may be holding it). Continuing would mark the whole architecture as migrated when it is not, costing hours of re-preprocessing on the next run — so it was refused.
backend.POOL_FINGERPRINT_UNREADABLE: One preprocessing pool's identity file could not be read (locked or damaged). Skipping it would mark this architecture as migrated while that pool is still in the old format, so the next run would rebuild it from scratch — refused. Try again later.
backend.POOL_SAMPLE_RATE_UNKNOWN: An RVC preprocessing pool has been used before, but holds no slices to read its sample rate from (a previous preprocessing run was probably interrupted). Guessing a rate would produce features computed at the wrong one — refused. Re-run preprocessing for this architecture.
backend.SLOT_NOT_MIGRATABLE: This architecture's folder layout could not be brought up to the current version, so「retrain」is refused for now — starting a second run would strand it on the old format permanently. There is usually a more specific reason above; fix that, restart the app and try again.
backend.RUN_ID_COLLISION: The directory name generated for the new run collided with a run that already exists. Refused rather than writing into it. Just press Start training again — a new name is generated each time.
backend.WARN_INDEX_CONTEXT_UNKNOWN: The import could not locate this model's training products (its workspace context was unavailable), so NO retrieval/cluster index was installed. The model works, but timbre similarity will be worse. Reopen the architecture's archive view from the project detail and retry; if the project was moved or deleted, check the data directory in Settings.
backend.RUN_AMBIGUOUS: This architecture slot holds more than one training run, so the target is ambiguous. Go back to the project detail and pick a specific run from that slot's list.
backend.RUN_NOT_FOUND: The requested training run does not exist — it may have been deleted, or the project was changed outside the app. Refresh the project detail and try again.
backend.RUN_ID_INVALID: The training run identifier is not a valid one. This usually means the request was hand-built, or a directory this app never created was placed in the workspace.
backend.RUN_CREATE_FAILED: Could not create the run directory for this training. Check that the data drive is writable, has free space, and is not locked by antivirus or a cloud-sync client.
backend.RUN_MIGRATE_FAILED: Upgrading the training workspace layout failed and was rolled back to its previous state; no files were lost. Make sure the drive is writable and restart the app to retry.
backend.SLOT_MIGRATE_FAILED: Upgrading the preprocessing-cache layout failed and was rolled back to its previous state; no files were lost. Make sure the drive is writable and restart the app to retry.
backend.POOL_FINGERPRINT_WRITE_FAILED: Could not write the preprocessing cache's identity file. The step was rolled back and the cache on disk is unchanged. Make sure the drive is writable and not locked by antivirus or a cloud-sync client, then restart the app to retry.
backend.SLOT_META_WRITE_FAILED: Could not write the training slot's layout marker file. The drive may be full or read-only.
backend.SLOT_META_ENCODE_FAILED: Failed to encode the training slot's layout marker. This is an internal error — please report it with the log.
backend.TRAINING_MIGRATE_UNDO_BLOCKED: The old training directory's migration could not be undone — the target is in use or locked. Close whatever is holding it (Explorer, antivirus, cloud sync) and retry.
backend.TRAINING_SCAN_JOIN: The background task that scans training archives ended abnormally. Retry; if it keeps happening, please report it with the log.
backend.ASSET_DL_BUSY: A model-asset download is already running — wait for it to finish
backend.ASSET_DELETE_FAILED: Could not delete the asset pack's files (something may be holding them — close Explorer/antivirus scans and retry)
backend.CUDA_DELETE_FAILED: Could not delete the CUDA runtime (the folder may be in use — close Explorer/antivirus scans and retry)
backend.CUDA_DELETE_IN_USE: This session is using the CUDA runtime, so it can't be deleted. Set Settings → Inference device to DirectML or CPU, restart the app, then delete it.
backend.CUDA_DOWNLOAD_BUSY: The CUDA runtime download is already running — wait for it to finish
backend.CUDA_GPU_REQUIRED: No NVIDIA GPU detected — CUDA is NVIDIA-only. Use the default DirectML (works on any GPU)
backend.CUDA_UNSUPPORTED_GPU: This GPU can't run the CUDA build (its compute capability is outside the supported range) — use DirectML instead (works on any GPU); switch the inference device to Auto or DirectML in Settings.
backend.DML_NEEDS_RESTART: The inference device is set to DirectML, but this session loaded the CUDA runtime — restart the app and try again (the runtime is chosen at startup).
backend.DOWNLOAD_HTML_RESPONSE: The download source returned a web page instead of the file (the mirror proxy is likely dead) — pick another GitHub mirror in Settings → Download Source
backend.CUDA_LOCAL_UNRECOGNIZED: Unrecognized file — pick only the official wheel / nupkg files listed below
backend.CUDA_LOCAL_BAD_FILE: File content not as expected (the official win_amd64 wheel is required)
backend.CONVERT_BUSY: A model conversion is already running — wait for it to finish and try again
backend.CONVERT_RENDER_BUSY: A render is in progress — start the conversion after it finishes
backend.CONVERT_LOW_MEMORY: Not enough memory to convert this model — the export ran out of memory. Close other memory-heavy applications and try again, or convert on a machine with more RAM.
backend.FRESH_RUN_FLAG_INVALID: The training config's “is this a new run” field holds a value that is not valid. This is an internal error — please report it with the log.
backend.FRESH_RUN_HAS_PRODUCTS: This run was supposed to be written into a brand-new run directory, but that directory already holds checkpoints from another run. Training stopped before any preprocessing so nothing would be overwritten — please report it with the log.
backend.MSST_ARCH_UNKNOWN: Cannot detect the model architecture from the filename
backend.RENDER_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to write the rendered audio to disk
backend.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Update check failed (network or update source unreachable)
backend.UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: Failed to launch the update installer
backend.UPDATE_NO_PENDING: No pending update (check for updates first)
backend.VOCAL_F0_FRAMES_MISMATCH: f0 frame count doesn't match the notes' total frames (render aborted to avoid pitch misalignment)
backend.VOCAL_SEGMENT_TOO_LONG: The vocal segment is too long — split it into multiple segments to render
backend.VOCODER_CONFIG_FIELD_MISSING: The vocoder config is missing a field — the mel format cannot be verified; re-import it
backend.VOCODER_CONFIG_MISSING: The vocoder's config file is missing — re-import it in the resource manager
backend.VOCODER_FILTER_SHAPE_MISMATCH: Vocoder filterbank shape doesn't match the config's num_mels
backend.VOCODER_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH: Vocoder/model geometry mismatch — shallow diffusion / the enhancer only support 44.1kHz/512 SoVITS models
backend.VOCODER_JSON_PARSE_FAILED: Failed to parse the vocoder .json config
backend.VOCODER_JSON_REQUIRED: Vocoder .onnx import requires a companion .json config (same name, same directory) — a vocoder without mel-spectrogram parameters is unusable
backend.VOCODER_MEL_FORMAT_MISMATCH: The vocoder's mel format doesn't match the model — a vocoder can only be used with models of the same mel format
backend.VOCODER_MEL_MISSING: The vocoder's mel filterbank file is missing — re-import the vocoder in the resource manager
backend.VOCODER_NOT_FOUND: Vocoder missing or deleted — re-select a vocoder in the node (or switch back to the default vocoder)
backend.VOCODER_NO_OUTPUT: The NSF-HiFiGAN vocoder returned no output
backend.VOCODER_PCNSF_UNSUPPORTED: PC-NSF (mini_nsf) vocoders are not supported yet — only classic NSF-HiFiGAN
backend.WARN_AUTO_F0_COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy the automatic pitch predictor — auto-f0 unavailable
backend.WARN_AUTO_F0_MISSING: The automatic pitch predictor file is missing — auto-f0 disabled for this model (re-import the .pth to restore)
backend.WARN_CLUSTER_CONVERT_FAILED: Cluster/retrieval model conversion failed — model imported, cluster enhancement unavailable
backend.WARN_CLUSTER_COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy the cluster asset
backend.WARN_CLUSTER_DIR_FAILED: Failed to create the cluster asset directory
backend.WARN_CLUSTER_EMPTY_OUTPUT: Cluster model conversion produced no .npy — model imported, cluster/retrieval unavailable
backend.WARN_CLUSTER_MULTI_COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy a multi-speaker retrieval asset
backend.WARN_DIFFUSION_CONVERT_FAILED: Diffusion model conversion failed — model imported, shallow diffusion unavailable
backend.WARN_DIFFUSION_COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy the diffusion attachment — shallow diffusion unavailable
backend.WARN_DIFFUSION_DIM_MISMATCH: The diffusion model's feature dim differs from the main model — they cannot work together; the attachment was removed
backend.WARN_DIFFUSION_VOCODER_CUSTOM: This model's shallow diffusion was trained against a FINE-TUNED vocoder, and vocoders are not imported with a model — if it sounds wrong, pick a different vocoder in the quality settings
backend.WARN_DIFFUSION_VOCODER_UNKNOWN: This model does not record which vocoder its shallow diffusion was trained against (nothing exported outside this app does) — it may have used a fine-tuned one; if it sounds wrong, pick a different vocoder in the quality settings
backend.WARN_INDEX_CONVERT_FAILED: Index file conversion failed — model imported, but retrieval enhancement unavailable
backend.WARN_INDEX_COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy the index file
backend.WARN_SIDECAR_REGENERATED: The model's .json config could not be parsed — regenerated with defaults
backend.WARN_SIDECAR_SYNTHESIZED: No companion .json config found — generated with defaults; if they don't match the model's real parameters, re-import with the config file
backend.WORKSPACE_BACKEND_MISMATCH: A same-named training workspace belongs to another backend — use a different model name, or retrain to wipe it (shallow diffusion requires a SoVITS workspace)
backend.WORKSPACE_DELETE_FAILED: Failed to delete the training workspace (the folder may be in use — close Explorer/antivirus scans and retry)
backend.WORKSPACE_MANIFEST_MISSING: The same-named training workspace lacks run_manifest.json (inconsistent state) — retrain (wipes the workspace) or use a different model name
backend.WORKSPACE_WIPE_FAILED: Failed to wipe the old training workspace
backend.XPU_NO_DEVICE: No usable Intel XPU GPU was found: torch-XPU supports only the Arc family (Arc A/B discrete cards, the Core Ultra "Arc Graphics" iGPU, Data Center GPU Max) — not Iris Xe / UHD / HD Graphics. Inference is unaffected (the default DirectML runs on any GPU); GPU acceleration for training and model conversion needs Arc or newer. If you do have an Arc card, install the latest Intel graphics driver and run the self-test again
backend.ZSTD_INIT_FAILED: Failed to initialize the zstd decoder
backend.RUN_NEVER_NAMED: This training run has no name yet — it has never started. The name is asked for when training first starts.
backend.RUN_RENAME_FAILED: The rename failed and the training name was left unchanged — the file may be locked or the disk may have errored. Try again.
backend.RENAME_WHILE_BUSY: A task is running — wait for it to finish (or stop it) before renaming this training run.
backend.RENAME_OTHER_INSTANCE: Another Utai instance is running and may be using this training run — the rename was refused. Close the other Utai windows first.
